gender.notes: Gender forbidden as an actuarial / pricing factor in insurance since 21 December 2012.

health.notes: Use lawful for risk assessment subject to Art. 9(2)(h) or Member State derogation.

genetic.legal_basis: Council of Europe Oviedo Convention Art. 12; national bans (e.g. France L1141-1)
genetic.notes: Genetic predictive test results may not be requested or used by insurers in most Member States.

age.legal_basis: Directive 2004/113/EC (recital allows proportionate use of age in insurance)
